entry.title: Único Serie Nasty Fritas — Single
experienceTags: Pairings: Espresso, dark chocolate, cola or dark rum (projected)
Occasion: Compact broad-gauge Liga session, after a meal, evening smoke
entry.summaryHtml: Espresso, dark chocolate, black pepper, earth, leather and natural sweetness drive Nasty Fritas' compact, broad-gauge take on the Papas Fritas concept. The short 4″ × 52 pyramid combines Connecticut Broadleaf, Brazilian Mata Fina and premium mixed-filler Liga tobaccos with a pigtail cap and closed foot, creating a thicker, more concentrated smoke than the standard Papas Fritas. Untasted here, so Strength 8 and Quality 8 remain projections and Flavour stays unrated.
entry.noteHtml: Untasted. Cigar of the Month Australia currently lists an available exact Nasty Fritas single at A$41 and 4″ × 52. Cigarworld lists a 4½″ × 52 single at A$38.35 but currently marks it temporarily unavailable. The catalogue uses the canonical 4″ × 52 specification. Flavour remains unrated until personally tasted.
productionLines: Handmade at La Gran Fabrica Drew Estate, Estelí
Filler: Honduran + Nicaraguan premium Liga trimmings
